Communities I have built or helped run, and manifestos I have translated into Turkish.

Software Craftsmanship Turkey

Founder, 2014 – now

A community for developers who care about their craft. More than 200 free meetups so far, and code retreats, including the Global Day of Coderetreat, which I have facilitated since 2013.

Agile Turkey

Community lead & product owner, 2015 – 2017

More than 50 free public meetups (Agile Buluşmalar) in two years. Product owner and organization lead of Agile Turkey Summit 2015 and 2016 and CraftSummit 2015.

Manifesto translations

Turkish

Part of the team that translated the Agile Manifesto. Turkish translator of the Software Craftsmanship Manifesto, the SOA Manifesto and the Disciplined Agile Manifesto.
